subject: Drafting the Final Charter Review Report
overview: The subcommittee finalized draft recommendations for the city's charter review, focusing on report organization and the separation of recall provisions. Members established a process for integrating survey data and public comments before presenting the draft to the full committee.

items.title: Minutes
items.summary: Approved the minutes of the previous meeting.

items.title: Review of Draft Recommendations
items.summary: Reviewed and revised recommendation sections including comments submitted by subcommittee members.

items.title: Survey Demographics and Analysis
items.summary: Discussed analyzing and including survey demographics to address the representativeness of community engagement efforts.

items.title: Article 8 Citizen Participation
items.summary: Decided to separate the recall provision into its own report section rather than lumping it with other citizen initiative measures.

items.title: Public Comment Integration
items.summary: Agreed to consolidate relevant public comments into a linked spreadsheet for the final report to maintain a manageable document length.

items.title: Appendix and Footnote Formatting
items.summary: Determined that the appendix will follow the order of document references and that footnotes will be placed within individual recommendation sections.

items.title: Budget Ordinances and Comparative Data
items.summary: Discussed state law limitations on budget recommendations and reviewed data comparing Medford’s council composition with other municipalities.

items.title: Report Merging and Distribution Process
items.summary: Decided to share the report with the full committee as separate files initially to avoid technical formatting conflicts between word processing platforms.

items.title: Report Visuals and Photography
items.summary: Discussed the inclusion of photographs in the final report and considered holding an in-person meeting for a committee group photo.
